import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

q = torch.tensor([[1.0, 1.0]])
k = torch.tensor([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 100.0]])
raw = q @ k.T
unit = F.normalize(q, dim=-1) @ F.normalize(k, dim=-1).T
print("原分數", raw)
print("原讀取比例", raw.softmax(-1).round(decimals=4))
print("L2正規化分數", unit.round(decimals=4))
print("L2正規化讀取比例", unit.softmax(-1).round(decimals=4))
print("有方向差的讀取比例", torch.tensor([1.0, 0.0]).mul(4).softmax(-1).round(decimals=4))
